statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); context_remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); user=$(whoami); host=$(hostname -s); dir_name=$(basename "$cwd"); git_info=""; if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then if ! git -C "$cwd" diff --quiet 2>/dev/null || ! git -C "$cwd" diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then git_status="*"; else git_status=""; fi; git_info=" $(printf '\033[36m')git:$(printf '\033[32m')$branch$git_status$(printf '\033[0m')"; fi; fi; context_info=""; if [ -n "$context_remaining" ]; then if awk "BEGIN {exit !($context_remaining < 20)}"; then color='\033[31m'; elif awk "BEGIN {exit !($context_remaining < 50)}"; then color='\033[33m'; else color='\033[32m'; fi; context_info=" $(printf "${color}")ctx:${context_remaining}%%$(printf '\033[0m')"; fi; printf '\033[34m%s@%s\033[0m \033[33m%s\033[0m%s%s' "$user" "$host" "$dir_name" "$git_info" "$context_info"
